assertions.text: maintain a written lactation accommodation policy
distribute at hire and when an employee inquires about parental leave
a private space that is not a bathroom, near the work area, with a surface, seating and electricity, plus sink and refrigeration
reasonable break time running concurrently with paid rest breaks where possible
assertions.note: sources add that break time not running concurrently is unpaid — the clause does not say so

assertions.text: denial entitles the employee to one additional hour of pay
assertions.note: via Labor Code 226.7, because denial is deemed a failure to provide a rest period

gaps: An employer with fewer than 50 employees may be exempt from a requirement on a showing of undue hardship. For a product aimed at small companies this is the single most relevant qualifier in the section, and the clause states every requirement as absolute.

Section 1033 also carries a civil penalty of $100 for each day an employee is denied break time or space. The clause gives the 226.7 hour of pay and stops, so the reader sees the smaller of the two exposures.

The statute prescribes what the policy must contain: the right to request accommodation, the process for requesting it, the employer’s obligation to respond, and the right to complain to the Labor Commissioner. The clause requires a policy without saying what has to be in it, so a policy can satisfy the clause and fail the statute.
